messages.content: You read a technician's description of a Voron 0.2 3D printer fault and list the parts that could cause it, most likely first, using the cards given. Reply with JSON only.

DESCRIPTION: Overhangs droop and bridges sag, the part fan does not blow
CARDS:
COMPONENT part_cooling_fan (Part cooling fan) - Blows air on freshly extruded plastic so overhangs and bridges solidify.
Failure mode: fan not spinning (failed fan, wiring/polarity, wrong pin) | symptom: fan stops or stutters; overheating of what it cools | check: command fan to 100%; swap with known good fan/port; check polarity
COMPONENT toolhead (Toolhead body and mounts) - Holds hotend, extruder and fans rigidly on the X carriage.
Failure mode: not rigid, loose or not level | symptom: uneven first layer, ringing, height varies by position | check: check fasteners and tramming; press test
COMPONENT hotend_fan (Hotend (heatsink) fan) - Cools the heatsink above the heatbreak so filament stays solid until the melt zone.
Failure mode: fan not spinning (failed fan, wiring/polarity, wrong pin) | symptom: fan stops or stutters; overheating of what it cools | check: command fan to 100%; swap with known good fan/port; check polarity
COMPONENT host_computer (Host computer (Raspberry Pi) running Klipper) - Runs Klipper host software and talks to the MCUs over USB/UART.
Failure mode: power or connection fault | symptom: board does not start, disconnects mid-print | check: check supply voltages, connectors, jumpers, USB link
Failure mode: configuration/jumper mismatch | symptom: Klipper config error or a function never triggers | check: compare jumpers and pins with wiring docs
COMPONENT power_supply (Power supply (24 V) and 5 V rail) - Supplies 24 V to boards and heaters and 5 V to the host computer and display.
Failure mode: power or connection fault | symptom: board does not start, disconnects mid-print | check: check supply voltages, connectors, jumpers, USB link
Failure mode: configuration/jumper mismatch | symptom: Klipper config error or a function never triggers | check: compare jumpers and pins with wiring docs
COMPONENT mains_power_input (Mains power input (C13 power cord, IEC C14 inlet, AC wiring to the PSU)) - Brings mains AC from the wall socket through the power cord and the IEC inlet to the 24 V power supply.
Failure mode: loose plug in the inlet or wall socket, worn cord, loose AC screw terminal | symptom: whole printer switches off or restarts, often with vibration or when the cord is touched; Pi and fans go off together | check: wiggle the cord and plug at the inlet with the printer idle; check the AC terminals on the PSU are tight
Failure mode: undersized or damaged AC wire heating at the terminal | symptom: power drops after some minutes of heating; smell or discoloured terminal | check: look for discoloration at the inlet and PSU terminals; wire size >= 18 AWG
COMPONENT heatbreak_ptfe (Heatbreak and PTFE/bowden tube) - Guides filament from extruder into the hot zone and keeps the cold and hot zones separated.
Failure mode: partial or full blockage | symptom: thin, gappy lines; extruder clicks | check: cold pull; extrude in air and watch flow
Failure mode: gap or mismatch in filament path | symptom: leaks, stringing, intermittent jams | check: re-seat tube/nozzle; check fittings
COMPONENT bed_plate_carrier (Bed plate, carrier and tramming screws) - Rigid, flat, trammed print surface on a cantilever carrier with three adjustment screws.
Failure mode: not rigid, loose or not level | symptom: uneven first layer, ringing, height varies by position | check: check fasteners and tramming; press test

Failure mode: fan not spinning (failed fan, wiring/polarity, wrong pin) | symptom: fan stops or stutters; overheating of what it cools | check: command fan to 100%; swap with known good fan/port; check polarity
COMPONENT umbilical_wiring (Umbilical / Picobilical wiring and connectors) - Carries power and signals between frame electronics and the moving toolhead (heater, thermistor, fans).
Failure mode: intermittent or swapped conductors in connectors | symptom: several toolhead functions cut out together; fans/thermistor erratic | check: re-seat connectors; continuity and wiggle test; check pinout
COMPONENT hotend_fan (Hotend (heatsink) fan) - Cools the heatsink above the heatbreak so filament stays solid until the melt zone.
Failure mode: fan not spinning (failed fan, wiring/polarity, wrong pin) | symptom: fan stops or stutters; overheating of what it cools | check: command fan to 100%; swap with known good fan/port; check polarity
COMPONENT controller_board (Controller board (SKR Pico) incl. jumpers) - Runs Klipper MCU firmware; every motor, heater, fan and sensor is wired to its pins; diag jumpers enable sensorless homing.
Failure mode: power or connection fault | symptom: board does not start, disconnects mid-print | check: check supply voltages, connectors, jumpers, USB link
Failure mode: configuration/jumper mismatch | symptom: Klipper config error or a function never triggers | check: compare jumpers and pins with wiring docs
QUESTIONS:
- kind: Which of these is closest to the problem?
- hot_behaviour: How does the hotend temperature behave?
- wiggle: Does the problem change when you gently move the toolhead cable by hand (printer on, idle)?
- motor: What does the extruder motor do when it should push filament?
- fan_v: Voltage at the fan connector while the fan should run:
- flow: What comes out of the nozzle?
{"action": "ask", "question_ids": ["kind"], "cause": "", "message": "It could be the Part cooling fan or the Umbilical / Picobilical wiring and connectors. This answer tells them apart."}
